state.background: Review only the proposed P42-490 plan. Current A1 in tests/e2e/real-consumption.e2e.spec.ts has summary.toContainText(/費目・四半期を変更（費目 \d+\/\d+・四半期 \d+\/4）・(全選択|絞り込み中)/). This state-derived content/count contract is proposed for one controlled test in tests/components/SpendingBarChart.test.tsx using the actual component with hiddenKeys=['食料'], hiddenQuarters=[2], and exact expected text `費目・四半期を変更（費目 1/2・四半期 3/4）・絞り込み中`; optionally clear filters and assert all-selected restoration. Existing U4 already pins default all-selected `費目 2/2・四半期 4/4・全選択`, so it is complementary but not filtered-state coverage. SpendingBarChart computes selectedLegendCount from legendKeys excluding hiddenKeys, selectedQuarterCount from quarters 1..4 excluding hiddenQuarters, and filtering state from either count being below total. The move tests this supplied-props component contract, not route wiring. In E2E replace only the content matcher with `expect(summary).toBeVisible()` after section visibility, adding real-route summary visibility evidence (the current matcher is not a visibility assertion). Keep P42-491/492 hidden legend visibility/count conditions and all other user interactions. Three plan artifacts mark plan pending, implementation not started, and agree on boundary. No tests have been run for P42-490.
acceptanceCriteria: The state-derived selected category/quarter counts and filtered status are covered by a real SpendingBarChart controlled-props test.
The existing default all-selected U4 is not mistaken for filtered-state coverage.
E2E retains summary visibility on the real route after removing state-derived text matching.
P42-491/492 closed details legend DOM/visibility/count and all route interactions remain browser-owned.
The plan, callsite ledger and responsibility matrix align and disclose that component props do not prove route wiring.
verification: Main plan checkpoint around line 144 and A1 plan row describe exact controlled test values and retain route visibility and P42-491/492.
Callsite ledger P42-490 identifies exact A1 matcher, U4 complementary default state, filtered expected string, route visibility replacement and scope boundary.
Responsibility matrix P42-490 records the same proposed unit test and retained browser evidence.
Source SpendingBarChart.tsx derives selectedLegendCount, selectedQuarterCount, and hasActiveLegendFilter from controlled props.
Existing U4 in SpendingBarChart.test.tsx checks only all-selected 2/2 and 4/4 state.
OpenSpec scenario states closed summary is one line and reports selected expense item/quarter counts and filter state.
A1 currently uses toContainText for summary content; replacing it with toBeVisible will add route-level visibility coverage, while section visibility already exists above it.
knownConstraints: This is plan review only; no unit implementation or tests for P42-490 exist yet.

Do not include credentials or authentication data.
state.outputRequirement: Return exactly one selected choice with confidence and probabilities for every choice. valid_as_defined means this proposed migration meets the criteria. For any non-pass, state a specific finding, affected requirement/location, observed evidence, and a concrete proposed fix or exact neededEvidence. Do not infer severity or invent details.

implementation.instructions: Is the proposed P42-490 migration plan valid as defined? Assess the unit/E2E responsibility split, summary visibility preservation and documentation alignment. Return the complete probability distribution.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The unit test equivalently covers filtered summary content, E2E preserves real-route visibility and closed-state browser checks, and docs align.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The proposed coverage conflicts with an explicit requirement; identify it and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: An exact prerequisite needed to decide/implement the plan is absent; identify it.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Evidence is insufficient to assess the coverage split; state exactly what is needed.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete testing or coverage issue exists; identify location, evidence and smallest fix.
criteria.scope_violation: The plan removes browser-owned behavior beyond P42-490; identify scope and correction.
criteria.other: A material issue does not fit the categories; provide finding and remedy or evidence needed.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify remaining uncertainty.
